page.notes: Layout: a Hebrew root dictionary page, two columns, no margin notes. The Hebrew words are largely unreadable at this scan resolution, so each is marked as illegible rather than guessed; the Latin glosses and grammatical abbreviations are transcribed. Upper-right area of the right column is blurred by a grey scan smudge around "defluxit" to "m. Rad.", so those words are doubtful. Top corners carry Hebrew letter marks (signature-like) and a page number that may read 489; the running head is not clear and is left out. The bottom-right catchword is a Hebrew word and is unreadable. The bottom-left "Nn 2" is the gathering signature. Lines were transcribed as list entries, one per printed entry; entries continuing across the column break are joined in the first left-column line.
